sport.en: Doing sports is good for our body and mind.

race.en: Tom won first place in the hundred-meter race.
race.cn: 汤姆百米赛跑得了第一。

team.en: Our team works together and helps each other win.
team.cn: 我们队合作互助才能赢。

win.en: If we practise harder, we will win the next match.
win.cn: 再努力训练，下场比赛我们会赢。

lose.en: Even when you lose, you still learn something important.
lose.cn: 就算输了，你也学到了重要的东西。

jump.en: He jumped over two meters in the long jump.

throw.en: He threw the small ball more than thirty meters.
throw.cn: 他把小球扔出三十多米。

cheer.en: All the parents cheered loudly from the side of the field.
cheer.cn: 所有家长在场边大声加油。
